verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a first-party catalog of 750+ platform integrations and an Events API built to ingest events from observability platforms. Of the named tools, only Sentry appears, and only as an SRE Agent connector for retrieving log data, not a documented alert-ingestion setup. The generic Events API is a building block, so it earns no credit toward named first-party integrations. Missing for 10: evidence of first-party Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus and CloudWatch integrations, documented setup guides for any of the named tools, a Sentry alert-ingestion integration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: With 750+ platform integrations, PagerDuty is a leader in connecting tools, data, and AI to your incident management process.
the SRE Agent can intelligently deduce the next steps for troubleshooting issues by retrieving log data from Sentry
